title: ROTA: measurement code, raw energy-counter data, and figure scripts (artifact of the BDCAT 2026 paper)
description: Artifact of the paper "ROTA: Measuring What Throughput Hides in the Energy Cost of Multi-GPU Communication Routes" (IEEE/ACM BDCAT 2026, short paper). It contains the CUDA benchmark and Slurm scripts used to measure energy per byte of GPU-to-GPU communication on NVIDIA H100 nodes, the raw NVML energy-counter data of every run reported in the paper, a verifier that recomputes every published aggregate from the raw counters, and the scripts that generate the three figures.
notes: Data (data/, figs/curve_data.json) and figures are licensed under CC BY 4.0; code under MIT. Measurements were taken on the REPACSS cluster at Texas Tech University.
